definitions.explanation: An exhibition of photographs, held in a gallery, museum, department store or public hall, by one photographer or on a theme.

examples.english: To go and see a photo exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ギャラリー→ギャラリー：10833_gyararii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{写真展|しゃしんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A photo exhibition is being held at the gallery in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{撮|と}りためた⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写真展|しゃしんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather held his first photo exhibition with the landscape photos he had taken since retiring.
